# A store at an offset is left alone when two iterations could touch the same
# element in an order the vector loop does not keep: a slice stored at two
# offsets, a read of the stored slice behind the stored element (a recurrence), a
# read at a distance that is not a constant, a read at another offset in a loop
# that counts down, and an offset the body changes. A stride and a nested index
# are not an offset.

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
! stderr .
! exists ops_simd.go
cmp ops.go ops.go.orig

loopvec -json .
cmpenv stdout stdout.want

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func TwoOffsets(a, b, c []int32) {
	for i := 0; i < len(b); i++ {
		a[i] = b[i]
		a[i+1] = c[i]
	}
}

func Recurrence(a, b []int32) {
	for i := 0; i < len(b); i++ {
		a[i+1] = a[i] + b[i]
	}
}

func DistanceUnknown(a []int32, k, n int) {
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		a[i+k] = a[i] * 2
	}
}

func CountingDownAhead(a []int32) {
	for i := len(a) - 4; i >= 0; i-- {
		a[i+1] = a[i+3] * 2
	}
}

func OffsetAssigned(dst, a []int32, off int) {
	for i := range a {
		dst[off+i] = a[i]
		off++
	}
}

func Stride(dst, a []int32) {
	for i := range a {
		dst[2*i] = a[i]
	}
}

func Nested(dst [][]int32, a []int32) {
	for i := range a {
		dst[0][i] = a[i]
	}
}
-- stdout.want --
